purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Budalangi Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session using the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 formula, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from a 250 DPI render of the page containing the printed cumulative TOTAL row (this constituency's polling stations span both PDF pages; the TOTAL row on the final page is the cumulative constituency-wide total, independently corroborated by the form's own 'Aggregate Results' and 'Voter Turn Out' summary boxes on the same page, which restate the identical registered-voters figure). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. The printed CON 231 header on the reviewed page was visually confirmed before recording. Note: the form's own printed 'Percentage of Voter Turnout' box divides only total valid votes (not valid+rejected) by registered voters; this evidence file follows the governed KDA turnout formula (total_valid_votes + rejected_ballots) / registered_voters instead of the form's own simplified summary-box percentage.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
